crossRefs.note: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

people.name: Herodion
people.line: A relative of Paul in Rome.

people.name: Narcissus
people.line: Christian in Rome with a household

translations.web: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
translations.bsb: Greet Herodion, my fellow countryman. Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
translations.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
translations.asv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Salute them of the household of Narcissus, that are in the Lord.
